## Checklist
- [ ] The repository's CI checks pass locally (lint, tests, `terraform fmt` and `validate` where they apply)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for changed behaviour
- [ ] No secrets, account IDs or real findings in source, tests or docs
- [ ] README and docs still match what the code does
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased", where the repository keeps one
